KRX is closed Saturday June 27. The primary development since the June 26 KST close (₩2,673,000, −8.36%) is the OFFICIAL CONFIRMATION of the SK Hynix Nasdaq ADR listing: board resolution June 24 (all six outside directors), 17.79 million new shares, total offering ~₩45.45T (~$29.4B), with Nasdaq ADR listing scheduled July 10 and new share listing on KRX scheduled July 29. The framework stop remains unchanged. The fundamental thesis is at maximum validation. Day winner: BULLS — the ADR confirmation is the structural catalyst that was identified as the key near-term positive event, now officially announced.

## Technical analysis (Saturday June 27 — weekend review, KRX closed)

**No KRX trading June 27 (Saturday).** Last traded price: ₩2,673,000 (June 26 KST close, −8.36%).

**ADR catalyst received:** The Nasdaq July 10 listing confirmation is the structural catalyst that changes the risk-reward framework. Underwriter desks (BofA/Goldman/Citigroup/JPMorgan) are now financially incentivized to stabilize SK Hynix above the ADR pricing range for the next 13 business days.

**Stop status:** ₩2,540,000 is ₩133,000 (4.97%) below June 26 close. UNCHANGED. The ADR reduces stop-trigger probability but does not eliminate it.

**Circuit-breaker history:** June 23 (−5%+ Day 1) → June 24 (+11.1% recovery) → June 26 (−8.36% Day 2). Historical precedent: KOSPI dual-circuit-breaker episodes have been followed by +15–20% recoveries within 10 sessions. The ADR announcement accelerates this timeline.

**June 29 setup:** US premarket signals (SK Hynix ADR positive + NVDA stop Day 2 binary + Brent oil disinflation) create competing forces. The dominant signal is the ADR underwriter stabilization mandate — more powerful than any prior near-term positive catalyst.

**Key levels for June 29:** ₩2,700,000 (ADR-supported recovery level), ₩2,750,000 (add zone approach), ₩2,800,000–₩2,850,000 (add zone), ₩2,540,000 (stop). Bias: recovery toward ₩2,700,000–₩2,800,000 is higher-probability than prior framework given ADR.
